samples.identity: HTML document lure delivering ZIP/UDF image
samples.reason: Auto-downloads a Base64 ZIP while claiming a document download. ZIP contains UDF .img with rundll32/DllInstall shortcut, DLL, and OOXML external mhtml OLE object targeting 185.234.247.119/123.RES. Rizin inspected the PE entry/header/imports; it has no DllInstall export, so no successful DLL activation or family identity is inferred solely from its filename. The embedded document and deceptive delivery establish hostile intent.
